name: campus-map-export-dependencies
description: Dependencies required to run the 3D Campus Map hero module

recommendedStack.notes: Tested and validated with React 19 and R3F v9 on Vite 6 / React 19.

react18AlternativeStack.notes: If the host project is using React 18, use R3F v8 and drei v9. The JSX and Canvas props in this module are identical and require NO code modifications.
react18AlternativeStack.codeChangesRequired: None. R3F 8 and drei 9 support all components used (Canvas, OrbitControls, Html, EffectComposer, Bloom).

installCommands.npm_react19: npm install three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei @react-three/postprocessing postprocessing zustand lucide-react && npm install -D @types/three tailwindcss autoprefixer postcss
installCommands.npm_react18: npm install three@^0.164.1 @react-three/fiber@^8.17.10 @react-three/drei@^9.121.4 @react-three/postprocessing@^2.16.2 postprocessing@^6.35.3 zustand@^4.5.5 lucide-react && npm install -D @types/three@^0.164.1 tailwindcss autoprefixer postcss
